metadata.title: सरना धर्म की परिभाषा क्या है । what is Sarna Dharm code demand | Tribal Philosaphy
metadata.description:
Sarna religion code bill was passed by the Jharkhand assembly on 11 November 2020. It was a long standing demand of tribal groups in the state of Jharkhand. But this is the first step towards acheiving a separate religious identity for the tribes in India. The parliament of India has to pass a law for that purpose. The biggest challenge is to have a consensus among the various tribal groups of the country on the name and provisions of a religion code.
